SELECT COUNT(d.disposal_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(od.order_detail_id), 0) AS disposal_rate_pct -- COUNT(od.order_detail_id) AS total_order_count, -- COUNT(d.disposal_id) AS total_disposal_count FROM order_details od JOIN orders o ON od.order_id = o.order_id LEFT JOIN disposals d ON od.order_detail_id = d.order_detail_id AND d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') WHERE od.order_status IN ('승인', '완료')
AND d.disposal_app_at >= #{startDate} AND d.disposal_app_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)

SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, COUNT(od.order_detail_id) AS totalOrderCount, COUNT(d.disposal_id) AS totalDisposalCount, COUNT(d.disposal_id) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(od.order_detail_id), 0) AS disposalRatePct FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN disposals d ON od.order_detail_id = d.order_detail_id AND d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') WHERE od.order_status IN ('승인', '완료')
AND d.disposal_app_at >= #{startDate} AND d.disposal_app_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY disposalRatePct DESC

SELECT i.ingredient_id AS ingredientId, i.ingredient_name AS ingredientName, SUM(d.disposal_price) AS totalDisposalPrice, SUM(d.disposal_quantity) AS totalDisposalQuantity FROM order_details od JOIN ingredients i ON od.ingredient_id = i.ingredient_id JOIN disposals d ON od.order_detail_id = d.order_detail_id AND d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') WHERE od.order_status IN ('승인', '완료') AND i.usable_flag != 'false'
AND d.disposal_app_at >= #{startDate} AND d.disposal_app_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY i.ingredient_id, i.ingredient_name ORDER BY totalDisposalPrice DESC

SELECT s.store_id AS storeId, s.store_name AS storeName, SUM(COALESCE(d.disposal_price, 0)) AS totalDisposalPrice, SUM(COALESCE(d.disposal_quantity, 0)) AS totalDisposalQuantity FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON s.store_id = o.store_id JOIN order_details od ON o.order_id = od.order_id LEFT JOIN disposals d ON od.order_detail_id = d.order_detail_id AND d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') WHERE od.order_status IN ('승인', '완료')
AND d.disposal_app_at >= #{startDate} AND d.disposal_app_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY s.store_id ORDER BY totalDisposalPrice DESC

SELECT DATE(d.disposal_app_at) AS disposalDate, COUNT(d.disposal_id) AS disposalCount, SUM(d.disposal_quantity) AS totalDisposalQuantity, SUM(d.disposal_price) AS totalDisposalPrice FROM disposals d WHERE d.disposal_status IN ('승인', '완료') AND d.disposal_app_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
AND d.disposal_app_at >= #{startDate} AND d.disposal_app_at < DATE_ADD(#{endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
GROUP BY DATE(d.disposal_app_at) ORDER BY disposalDate DESC
